'''Explorer Squad Esk-23''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] stationed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the squad was abandoned and joined forces with the remains of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]. Under the command of [[347.609/D5]], they discovered an [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]], which they [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|assaulted]]. Esk-23 were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and equipped with [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].
